description: Get step-by-step fixes to relay to the traveler when an eSIM will not install or has no data. Use it when a delivered order's traveler reports a problem, before regenerate_activation or request_refund. Example: {order_id: "ord_...", device: {os: "ios", model: "iPhone 15"}, symptom: "no_data"}. Returns ordered steps for an order's eSIM that does not install (cant_install_qr) or does not work (no_data, no_signal, slow), worded for the phone (device.os ios or android, device.model if known): eSIM compatibility and carrier lock, install by QR or manual entry (SM-DP+ address and activation code), data roaming on the eSIM line, the eSIM as the data line, the APN when the plan has one, airplane-mode toggle and restart, then the escalation (regenerate_activation, request_refund with reason not_working and the evidence to include, or order_status for a code not delivered yet). Also returns the order's status and the plan's APN, networks and network types (plan_facts); activation and usage only as the supplier reports them. Read-only: it reissues nothing and opens no dispute. Any agent of the order's principal may call it; other principals get ORDER_NOT_FOUND. A refunded or failed order gets no steps.

agent_key.description: Secret returned by register_agent (or X-Agent-Key header)

device.description: The traveler's phone: os (ios or android) and, if known, model

model.description: Phone model if known, e.g. iPhone 15 or Pixel 8

os.description: The traveler's phone operating system: ios or android

order_id.description: Order id from purchase (order.order_id) or from an earlier order_status call

principal_id.description: The principal you act for (or X-Principal-Id header)

symptom.description: What the traveler sees: cant_install_qr (the eSIM will not install), no_data (installed but no internet), no_signal (no network) or slow

name: troubleshoot
title: Troubleshoot an eSIM
